items.title: Harry Fairconnetue Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: I think we sent for Warren and Edgar one time... George McCollum left the band... I think it was Wayne, Nebraska.

ctx.x: Uh... That was playing piano, Howard. Uh, Warren was playing piano.
And then, uh, when we were getting the jam for another horn, when he played saxophone, a clarinet, you know, Warren. Warren who?
